$schemaNote: LLP 0184 Phase 1 item 6 backfill: hand-authored operability/surfaceAccess/behavior overrides keyed by the post-join operation identity (host_ops.* stripped to its LLP 0024 spelling, e.g. 'host_ops.app.inspect' -> 'app.inspect'). scripts/generate-control-catalog.mjs applies these on top of its structurally-derived surfaceAccess (native/cliOnly/mcpOnly/apiOnly from projection presence) — operability itself is NEVER derived automatically (the RFC requires per-operation authored classification, never compiler inference, since it is a security disagreement axis the compiler must not resolve toward permissive). Every row not listed here defaults to operability 'unavailable' with a generic 'not yet classified' reason so an un-triaged row can never silently read as agent-invokable — see the compiler's DEFAULT_UNCLASSIFIED constant. This file covers: (a) the RFC's 'already good' research-snapshot list (network profiles, lifecycle, telemetry, errors, assets), (b) every RFC worked example (host.restart, admin link, acceptance.run, config.set/unset, the dev-mailbox pin), and (c) the direct_runner/app.ensure.provision family already well-understood from LLP 0024/0031.

host.start.mcpDeferralReason: snapback_start exists but is a distinct MCP-only projection today (this row's own HTTP/CLI path is the source of truth for surfaceAccess derivation; see host.restart below for the composed case).

host.restart.cliDeferralReason: Nothing prevents a `snapback restart` CLI command composing Start/Stop the same way `snapback_restart` does; not implemented yet. Phase 2 lands it (LLP 0184 §Product contract).

projectionCredentials.mcp: local process/filesystem access plus the startup nonce — no admin credential gate (LLP 0184 §Design/2's disclosed, temporary, named exception; closed in Phase 2's host.restart vertical slice)

asset.put.mcpDeferralReason: Assets: full typed CLI, zero MCP tools today — the RFC's (cliOnly, direct) worked example (§Product contract). MCP projection is a Phase 2 P1 item.

unavailableReason.note: Pinned by LLP 0024, not yet built anywhere. Returns SNAPBACK_HOST_OP_UNIMPLEMENTED.
Pinned by LLP 0024, not yet built anywhere. Returns SNAPBACK_HOST_OP_UNIMPLEMENTED.
The shipped, exposed-but-unbuilt MCP tool (snapback_acceptance_run) returns SNAPBACK_HOST_OP_UNIMPLEMENTED. Supported, LLP 0024-pinned future operation — not internal.
The unrecognized-function-kind branch; carries EffectPolicy::Unavailable on its own registration.

app.ensure.provision.note: Provisioning is invoked through the /app/ensure HTTP path only today; no direct CLI/MCP tool wraps this specific dispatched intent yet.

admin.link.mint.mcpDeferralReason: No MCP tool yet; a one-time operator claim link is a human-redemption artifact (LLP 0184 §Product contract's cliOnly/mediated worked example).
admin.link.mint.note: snapback admin link (src/cli.rs AdminCommand::Link) — mints, observes, reattaches to, or revokes a one-time operator claim link via POST /_snapback/api/console/claim(/exchange|/status|/revoke). Human redemption is the operation's whole point, so every leg is mediated regardless of surfaceAccess (rule 6).

config.status.mcpDeferralReason: No `snapback config` CLI subcommand exists today; gated HTTP twin only until Phase 1's projection lands (§Product contract/P3).

config.set.mcpDeferralReason: No MCP secret carrier is defined (§Product contract): stdin/fd is a CLI-process carrier with no MCP equivalent. Promoting to native requires a defined, security-owner-approved MCP secret carrier first.
config.set.note: Carries a secret value via stdin/fd (the only v1 carrier). Human entry through the existing browser/operator setup page needs no agent-facing handoff row — the agent is never in that call chain.

cron.tick.note: AdminClient.tickCron() (packages/snapback-admin-client/index.mjs:577); RFC research snapshot: shipped but lacks a direct control CLI/MCP projection.

ephemeral.cleanup.note: AdminClient.cleanupEphemeral() (index.mjs:603); RFC: 'Effectively hidden from agents and classified only as notAuthorFacing' today — this Phase 1 row records the operation as genuinely direct so a future CLI/MCP projection (Phase 2 P2) is a pure surfaceAccess widening, not an operability change.

connection.disconnect.note: RFC: 'Most hidden shipped control: has only a notAuthorFacing surface-map row, no CLI/MCP/AdminClient projection' — the route itself works and is admin-gated; an agent with an admin credential can call it directly today even without a wrapper.

secretRead.mint.mcpDeferralReason: Ready-file-only local operator authority (src/cli.rs HostCommand::SecretReadMint doc comment: 'can never be discovered from a URL'); no MCP projection.

inspect.note: Public admin-projected read alias of app.inspect's HTTP surface; distinct route from POST /_snapback/api/host-ops's app.inspect operation.

console.credential.internalReason: Browser-console session-credential bootstrap machinery consumed by AdminClient's own private #restoreReachabilityCredential/#renewConsoleCredential methods, not an author/operator action a client invokes directly.

console.approval.request.mcpDeferralReason: No MCP tool yet; approving a short-lived console-displayed code is a human action by design (src/cli.rs AdminCommand::Approve).

push.maintenance.internalReason: Push-notification maintenance sweep; internal scheduled/system maintenance, not an author/operator-invoked action today.

client-mutations.purge.internalReason: Internal client-mutation-log retention maintenance; not an author/operator-invoked action today.

config.unset.note: Carries no secret value — LLP 0036 specifies a 1:1 snapback_config_* MCP mapping alongside the CLI verb, so both projections land together (§Product contract/P3). A P2-style controlled mutation.

auth.mailbox.read.pinReason: CredentialSecret responseSensitivity + ImpersonationCapability-adjacent effect: usage-evidence promotion to native/cliOnly/mcpOnly is refused outright per §Product contract's promotion-refusal rule, regardless of call volume. An authored override, not a threshold, is the only way past this pin, and only after passing the same secret-carrier review config.set requires.
auth.mailbox.read.note: src/server.rs's route_registry() exports this row directly: GET /_snapback/api/auth/mailbox, AdminWrite policy, CredentialSecret responseSensitivity. The compiler's promotion-refusal check keys off this exact policy fact from the live export, not this override file, so this entry documents intent rather than driving enforcement.
